# Engrant

> Engrant is an AI grant-research tool that finds funders that aren't in any commercial grant database, and returns each one pre-evaluated for fit, eligibility, competition, and red flags.

Audience: people doing grant search without a research team - solo consultants, boutique shops, and one-person development functions at small nonprofits

Geography: worldwide - Engrant is not limited to any region, and not limited to the coverage area of any database

Pricing: $47/month monthly, $37/month billed annually ($444/year). 14-day free trial, no credit card required.

Founder: Artem Smirnov (https://www.linkedin.com/in/artemsmirnov/)

## Product

- https://engrant.eu/ - Homepage: discovery positioning, Recently Found feed, pricing, FAQ
- https://engrant.eu/pricing/ - Two-tier pricing ($47/mo, $444/yr) with feature list and comparison table
- https://engrant.eu/about/ - Canonical entity page: founder, founding date, geography, how it works
- https://engrant.eu/how-engrant-search-works/ - Parallel AI agent search architecture explained
- https://engrant.eu/ngo-search/ - English landing page for in-house nonprofit fundraisers
- https://engrant.eu/buscar-convocatorias/ - Spanish landing page (same product, es interface)
